text.introduction: BD+67 1294 shares its motion through space with TOI-6034, 4,700 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: BD+67 1294's orbit around TOI-6034 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
